cues.text: You and Shinjiro stand at the snack counter in the movie theater lobby, other customers waiting beside you. Shinjiro rubs the back of his head.
You and Shinjiro take your seats among the audience, Shinjiro with his arms folded, and the film begins.
The film ends. Back at the snack counter, Shinjiro stands beside you, his head low, his face drawn and sad.
Shinjiro tugs his cap down, turns and walks away, leaving you behind.
